title: Rally, then the top
description: Two upswings take price from 67,400 to the 70,200 high (15 Mar 18:00), whose close is the second break of structure. Two hours later the close of 67,861 breaks the last pullback low (67,894): a bearish market structure break. After the high the swings are downswings, inside the incomplete leg down to 66,882.
